items.stem: Why should you avoid typing personal details like your full name and address into an AI tool?

options.text: You cannot be sure how that information is stored or used, so keeping it private protects you
options.rationale: Correct: protecting private information keeps you safe.

options.text: Because AI tools charge money per letter
options.rationale: The reason is privacy and safety, not cost.

options.text: Because it makes the AI answer slower
options.rationale: The concern is privacy, not speed.

options.text: There is no reason; it is always safe
options.rationale: It is safer to keep personal details private.

items.explanation: Correct: protecting private information keeps you safe.

items.stem: Which TWO are responsible ways to use an AI tool for schoolwork? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Checking the AI's answer against a trusted source
options.rationale: Correct: verifying answers guards against mistakes.

options.text: Being honest that AI helped and giving credit
options.rationale: Correct: honesty about AI's help is responsible.

options.text: Copying the answer without reading or checking it
options.rationale: Blindly copying risks spreading mistakes and is dishonest.

options.text: Typing a classmate's private information into it
options.rationale: Sharing others' private details is unsafe and unkind.

items.explanation: Correct: verifying answers guards against mistakes.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: An AI gives a very confident answer that you suspect is wrong. What should you do?

options.text: Check it against a trusted source before using it
options.rationale: Correct: AI can be confidently wrong, so verify important answers.

options.text: Trust it because it sounded sure
options.rationale: A confident tone does not mean the answer is correct.
Spreading unchecked answers can pass on mistakes.
AI can make mistakes and should be checked.

items.explanation: Correct: AI can be confidently wrong, so verify important answers.
